description: T-057 spell_aoe: a level-15 mage casts fireball with three giant rats in the room; never resisted; events compared with the amounts masked. T-084: giant rats (monster 1, 12 hit points), not goblins (90): a fireball does at least 33 damage (WCCSPELS fireball minval 33) and hits every monster in the room, so the one cast that lands kills all three together and the fight is over before the exit. With goblins the first kill ended the caster's autocombat (distribute_experience; *Combat Off*) while survivors went on hitting him, and an attack during the exit's meditation cancels the exit (stop_users_exit). Needs the developer code on both sides: on the original CODEC_OF_TWINKS=78 in wccmmud.ini (STAGE_CODEC_OF_TWINKS or docker -e CODEC_OF_TWINKS) and the BBS key WCCSYSOP on the sysop account (mbbsemu_key.py; TWEAK, SUMMON, EXPRESS_TRAIN, MONSTER), on silvermere the DEBUG grant (`silvermere account grant sysop DEBUG`); and the BBS sysop account sysop/sysop with its character Sysadm on both (docs/testing.md, M4). Steps 18-20 are one block (merge_steps): the cast, the wait for the three kills, a bare Enter once the output is quiet.

SUMMON finds the scroll of fireball first
fireball costs 34: enough for the whole fight (short of mana the auto-combat goes on silently without a cast and may never end)
three giant rats (12 hit points each: one fireball kills all three)
by hand an area attack spell engages; the cast comes with the round

all three rats dead: one *Combat Off* per kill, searched from the cast on. silvermere answers the whole fight within the cast's own step, the original a tick later, so the wait cannot be for text after this step starts (run 38918299935: 'explodes' had already come)

a bare Enter once the output has been quiet for 2 s: the three rats died to one fireball, so the room is empty and no attack can reach the exit. Their deaths and the *Combat Off* of each kill come in the same burst as the explosion (step 19) or just after it, so steps 19-20 are one block (merge_steps) and the structure is required of the block
